note: 27.7 s, native 32 px/m crops (no scaling), real time, arena director chapters (dev/arena/arena.tscn --bot=reel). Reads clearly at 32: the shard victim no longer buried in smoke, the chain's arcs and tossed pistols, the plasma smoke column and scorch, the melee smear fan across the victim on the cut frames. Melee chapters re-rendered on 9dca555b: the striking arm draws over the victim, so the claw jab shows as a grey arm across the blue chest on the hit frames. Smallest at 32: the single-tap electro jolt (the body is about 20 px; the spits carry it). The baton's 48/64 slow A/B is melee_baton_ab_48ppm_64slow.mp4 and baton_smear_linger_ab_48ppm_64slow.mp4.
